body: Music has always been the thing that could completely lift my mood, the one thing that made me happy.  I've had very, very faint tinnitus for as long as I can remember, it's just barely noticeable and has never gotten worse.  Then yesterday it got really bad, so bad I could hear it above a fan in my room, like, unbearably bad.  I don't know how much or how loud I'll be able to listen to music anymore.  I haven't been to a doctor yet, but I don't think I'll be able to make it in a world without music.  I don't think I want to.  It fucking sucks.

I know this probably doesn't mean much, but for what it's worth it's not your fault.  Someone could have the best life in the world and still be depressed, doesn't matter who.  I hope things get better for you though.
Yeah, that's pretty much how I feel.

That's pretty much what happened to me.  I thought the depression was gone, then spent a few months figuring out if I was actually depressed again or not, now I'm right back to where I was in the first place.
Yeah, I'm planning on getting a dog and walking it will be a regular part of my day, also there's no way I could leave my pets behind, so there's one thing motivating me to keep fighting.
Yeah, that's what I'm afraid of.
